scope.summary: Host request policy covers redirects, DNS/address changes, loopback, link-local, private networks, IPv4/IPv6, files, and custom schemes.
acceptance_criteria: Host request policy re-evaluates redirects and DNS/address changes and governs loopback, link-local, private networks, IPv4/IPv6, files, and custom schemes.
[positive] Declared public and development-profile targets pass each policy phase with attributable decisions.
[negative] Redirect/DNS rebinding to denied address classes, file targets, or custom schemes is blocked on re-evaluation.
[failure_recovery] Resolver/policy failure aborts the request and leaves no privileged connection or cached allow decision.
[concurrency] Parallel requests cannot reuse another origin, profile, or development-profile allowance.

requirements: Use the application-injected typed StageRepository and canonical embedded SurrealDB/EventLedger authority.
Do not introduce Turso, libSQL, SQLite, PostgreSQL, a feature-private database engine, fallback storage, or dual-write authority.
Keep ArtifactStore as byte/manifests/hash/retention/materialization authority and browser-engine profile files as non-canonical isolated engine materialization.
proof_when_applicable: SurrealKit SCHEMAFULL rollout with assertions, indexes, and authenticated record-user permissions
restart/reopen and concurrency proof appropriate to the MT
zero-match guard for forbidden database dependencies, drivers, URLs, migrations, fixtures, caches, fallbacks, and compatibility paths

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Bind at implementation: headless/backend MT records typed NOT_APPLICABLE reason; operator-visible behavior requires Argus.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
Legacy Stage code (WP-12) must not silently constrain this MT (STAGE-DEC-017).
Do not duplicate ArtifactStore, WP-1 ToolGate/process/promotion, or Loom authority.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

planning_metadata.implementation_note: Planning-stage MT. Exact owned_files, code anchors, and proof_commands are bound at the L00 integration baseline. Deep spec detail lives in corpus_refs; acceptance_criteria carry the provable closure unit and the positive/negative/failure_recovery/concurrency case groups.
